deficiencies.description: The rewrite adds the contrastive word 'whereas' to state a link between a meningioma causing pressure and a lung carcinoma causing blockage, which the text simply juxtaposes.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: things like a meningioma will cause pressure. Things like a lung carcinoma will cause blockage.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: a meningioma will cause pressure, whereas a lung carcinoma will cause blockage.

deficiencies.description: The rewrite uses 'which' to state a causal link, making the build-up of secretions the cause of breathing difficulties and the breeding ground for infection. In the text, these are listed independently alongside the build-up as parallel effects.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: this builds up secretions within the lungs, makes it harder for people to breathe, is a breeding ground for infection.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: this leads to a build-up of secretions within the lungs, which makes breathing harder and provides a breeding ground for infection.

deficiencies.description: The rewrite introduces a general statement that other effects depend on the site, which the lecturer did not state.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: Other effects depend on the site.

deficiencies.description: The rewrite omits the word 'function' when describing what tumours in the bones erode.

The rewrite uses a colon to state a link between ulceration and the cauliflower-like structure, implying one explains or defines the other, whereas the text just lists them sequentially without a stated link.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: Also ulceration, you saw that enormous cauliflower structure within the colon.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: Ulceration is another effect: the enormous cauliflower-like structure seen within the colon

deficiencies.description: The rewrite clarifies the text's incomplete phrase 'the normal' by specifying 'normal tissue', choosing one clear reading.
The rewrite clarifies the text's unclear statement 'these will interfere' by specifying that the tumour will interfere with the haematopoietic stem cells, choosing one clear reading.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: the hematopoietic stem cells that are there, these will interfere.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: where the haematopoietic stem cells are located, will interfere with them.

deficiencies.description: The rewrite adds the word 'therefore' to state a causal link between the niche not being very big and the tumour interfering with the bone marrow, which the text does not state.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: This niche is not very big. This will interfere with your bone marrow
deficiencies.rewritePassage: This niche is not very big. The tumour will therefore interfere with the bone marrow

deficiencies.description: The rewrite distorts the text by stating that a tumour occurs 'in a meningioma', whereas the text refers to the meningioma itself as an example of a tumour.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: if they're occurring in things like the meningioma that I was telling you about or in the liver.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: when the tumour occurs in a meningioma or in the liver.

considerations.sourcePassage: Well, as I was hinting at, it interferes with normal functions.
considerations.reason: Replacing the pronoun 'it' with its unambiguous antecedent 'cancer' is an allowed change that does not alter the meaning.

considerations.sourcePassage: This all sounds very terrible in terms of ways in which to die. So there's lots of pain and debilitation,
considerations.reason: The text uses 'So' to link the terrible ways to die with the specific symptoms, which the rewrite equivalently represents using a colon, adding no new link.

considerations.sourcePassage: As I said, the bone marrow will fail altogether
considerations.reason: Dropping the conversational repetition 'As I said' is an allowed omission of a remark to the audience.
This is a filler remark by the lecturer, and dropping such remarks is an allowed change.
